wire/press-by-number.why: app.press: 2 (a YAML number) presses the element at index 2, as "2" does; on main it failed with a TypeError

surface/usage.why: the first line names Flutter beside React Native

surface/help/case run.why: --net-cache, --net-record and --net-record-credentials: a folder of recorded fetches a host answers from; nothing changes for a run that does not pass them

surface/help/fastsim grant.why: --runtime picks the Flutter host's build; without it a React Native folder gets the same variant as on main

surface/help/fastsim install.why: --runtime and a paragraph on the Flutter host; without --runtime a React Native folder installs the same variant as on main

surface/help/headless start.why: the summary and details name flutter test beside jest

surface/help/init.why: --runtime and --headless (Flutter only), and the details name Flutter; init in a React Native folder writes what it did on main

surface/help/map build.why: details added: how a Flutter app's routes are read beside React Navigation's

surface/help/smoke.why: --params says Flutter reads route params with its routes

surface/mcp/instructions.why: the MCP instructions name Flutter and add a paragraph on setting up and testing a Flutter app

surface/mcp/tool/case_run.why: the net_cache, net_record and net_record_credentials arguments of case run

surface/mcp/tool/fastsim_install.why: the runtime argument and the Flutter paragraph of fastsim install

surface/mcp/tool/init.why: the runtime and headless arguments of init and its details naming Flutter

detect/flutter app/runtime.why: a pubspec that takes flutter from the SDK, with no react-native dependency, is a Flutter app

detect/flutter app beside a package.json.why: a package.json that does not depend on react-native leaves a Flutter pubspec beside it a Flutter app

detect/flutter app beside a broken packa.why: a package.json that cannot be read names no react-native, so the Flutter pubspec decides

detect/flutter app with a tsconfig/runti.why: a tsconfig without react-native in package.json does not make a Flutter folder React Native

detect/flutter app, inline sdk/runtime.why: `flutter: { sdk: flutter }` is a Flutter pubspec to every command now that one module detects the runtime; before, only init read it so
